4417.title: Runtime PATH shadows an existing bb executable
4417.rootCauseOneLine: Actual runtime environment preparation prepends the product CLI directory, changing bare-command and env-shebang lookup.
4417.proposedFix: Use unambiguous product command paths while preserving existing same-name programs; audit bare-bb callers.
4417.caveats: Two clean Linux/dash child-process runs with synthetic executables; no actual Babashka, fish or provider session.
